Turn things to make them fit

An arriving item may lie on its side when that is the only way it fits - a 2x1 box of cartridges into a 1x2 gap. Last resort only: nothing that fits as it is is ever turned, and nothing gets into a section its upright width was refused from. Turn it back by hand and that is remembered instead.
Mark what will not fit

In a body's or a stash's list, a red ground behind anything there is no room for in your bag right now - counting piles it could join, not only free squares. It answers the question you are asking while you look at a corpse: what of this can I take.
When there is no room

Drop under player is what has always happened: it comes in and what does not fit ends up on the ground. Block refuses it instead - taking from a body or a stash, including Take All, simply does not happen and the item stays where it is. A thing you walk over cannot be refused: the engine takes it before any script is asked, so those still land at your feet.
